observation: Page titles differ: A uses a decorative dotted-punctuation title; B uses a cleaner title with an em dash and the country name.
evidence: A title '.:Alpine Everest Expedition & Trek :.'; B title 'Alpine Everest Expedition & Trek — Nepal'; B em_dashes=1, A=0.

observation: A has three h1 elements (welcome, Gallery, Products) and no h2. B has one h1 followed by a h2/h3 hierarchy.
evidence: A h1_count=3, h2=null; B h1_count=1, four h2 and one h3 (outline: Quality service..., Gallery, Products, Contact Information; h3 Recommend this site to a Friend).

observation: A uses no HTML5 landmark elements. B uses header, nav, main, five sections and a footer.
evidence: A semantic counts all 0; B header 1, nav 1, main 1, section 5, footer 1.

observation: A is built on legacy markup: tables, br tags, a font tag, object/embed/param Flash elements, and many divs.
evidence: A tag_counts: table 2, td 7, br 29, font 1, object 2, embed 2, param 6, div 44. B has none of these and uses flex/grid (display_grid 11, display_flex 11).

observation: A uses no flex or grid, so it is positioned by absolute and float layout. B uses flex and grid containers throughout.
evidence: A display_grid 0, display_flex 0; B display_grid 11, display_flex 11.

observation: A is a short page, 1363px tall, with a compressed two-column layout. B is a long single-column page of stacked full-width sections, 3575px tall.
evidence: A page_height 1363; B page_height 3575; both width 1440.

observation: A has a fixed-width centered white container (about 980px, x 230–1210) on a dark scenic background. B uses a full-bleed layout with content aligned to a ~1040px column starting at x=200.
evidence: A screenshot: white panels from x≈230 to 1210 over a sky-and-grass backdrop. B images start at x=200 and cards end at x≈1240.

observation: A's page background is a dark scenic sky gradient with silhouetted grass and black side bands. B has no scenic background and uses cream, white and slate blocks.
evidence: A body_bg rgb(0,0,0), with a visible grass-silhouette image at the edges. B body_bg rgb(251,248,241).

evidence: A images aimg2.jpg and aimg7.jpg are 16x16 with natural size 0x0 (broken). B nav ul has 4 li, and the wordmark is text.

observation: B has a full-width hero with a vertical gradient from slate blue through teal to sand. It has a large serif headline, a subhead, and two CTA buttons. A has no hero or CTA.
evidence: B h1 57.6px Georgia white; gradient_backgrounds 2; buttons 'Plan a trip' and 'Featured tours'. A h1 is 16px.

observation: The H1 differs sharply in scale and style. A is 16px Verdana bold in navy, with 'Welcome to Alpine Everest' in olive green. B is 57.6px Georgia bold in white.
evidence: A h1 font_size 16px, rgb(39,66,120), Verdana; B h1 57.6px, Georgia, rgb(255,255,255).

observation: A uses Verdana for nearly all text. B pairs Georgia serif for headings and body paragraphs with system-ui sans for nav, buttons and labels.
evidence: A fonts: Verdana 195, verdana 41, Arial 4, Times New Roman 1. B fonts: Georgia 67, system-ui 54.

observation: A's body text is small and grey, about 11px, in dense narrow columns. B's body text is 16px with a 26.4px line height and a wider measure.
evidence: A body_line_height 'normal'; top text color rgb(102,102,102) on 85 elements. B body_line_height 26.4px, body_color rgb(34,49,60).

observation: B adds small uppercase, letter-spaced eyebrow labels above section headings (ABOUT US, MOMENTS, FROM NEPAL, GET IN TOUCH) in teal. A has none.

observation: A uses a navy/olive two-tone H1 and teal-blue underlined nav links. B uses a slate, cream and red scheme with a single red accent.

evidence: A screenshot: Home, About Us, Testimonials, Contact Us at y≈329 with blue underlines. B nav at top right, white text.
